Original · Unique Research · 2026-06-12

Editor's note: This is an announcement piece about the inaugural SG AI 30 list. The institutional voice and all descriptive claims belong to the original Chinese source. Named companies and sectors are preserved as source attributions.

SG AI 30

SG AI 30 Is Officially Launched

Recognizing Representative Innovators in Singapore's AI Ecosystem

"

Singapore is not a large country, but its position on the global AI map extends far beyond its land area.

Singapore is not a large country, but its position on the global AI map extends far beyond its land area. Over the past five years, the most active AI capital in Asia-Pacific has flowed through here, regional headquarters of the world's top technology companies have settled here, and countless entrepreneurs have chosen to plant their first Asia-Pacific flag on this soil. Beyond the spotlight, a cohort of enterprises is quietly and solidly using AI to rewrite finance, healthcare, retail, content, agriculture, and every corner of daily life.

Today, we officially bring their names to light.

What Is "SG AI 30"?

SG AI 30 is the first Singapore AI representative enterprise list we have initiated, selecting 30 companies from dozens of candidates and publishing it globally.

There are only three selection criteria —

Geographic roots: headquartered in Singapore, or using Singapore as the core Asia-Pacific operating hub

AI-native: AI is a core component of product capability, business model, or industry solution — not an add-on feature or marketing label

Deployment value: has formed verifiable commercial deployment or ecosystem impact in its respective sector

This is not a fundraising scale ranking, nor a popularity contest — it is a genuine record of "substantive AI value."

Thirty Companies, Covering These Directions

The 30 selected companies span eight sectors, forming a panoramic view of Singapore's AI ecosystem.

Fintech & Risk-Control AI

Anti-fraud, identity verification, credit scoring, compliance monitoring, robo-advisory... Singapore is one of the most fintech-dense locations in Asia-Pacific, and AI is already deeply embedded in its financial scenarios. The list includes unicorns serving hundreds of millions of users with identity verification, RegTech pioneers using AI to detect financial crime, and newcomers redefining credit assessment with alternative data.

Healthcare & Life Sciences

From telemedicine to mental health intervention, from smart scheduling for home care to wearable health monitoring, AI is extending medical services beyond the clinic. Singapore's aging population pressure coexists with high-level medical infrastructure, giving its health AI companies a natural combination of global vision and local depth.

Marketing & Content Creation AI

AI copywriting, AI-generated video ads, AI-driven influencer marketing... the paradigm of content production is being thoroughly restructured. The list includes AI content factories serving global e-commerce, as well as AI marketing platforms focused on brand-creator collaboration — all pointing to the same trend: creativity is no longer exclusively human.

Enterprise Intelligence & Customer Interaction

Conversational AI customer service, omnichannel sales automation, AI-driven financial data consolidation, intelligent talent matching... the underlying logic of enterprise digital transformation is being rewritten by AI. These companies serve not individuals but organizations — their clients span banks, retailers, HR departments, and multinational enterprises.

AI Infrastructure & Agent Platforms

Where some build applications, others lay the foundation. Local large models, multilingual data networks, enterprise-grade AI Agents, decentralized inference infrastructure... Singapore has also produced a cohort of companies focused on building underlying AI capabilities — indispensable cornerstones of the ecosystem.

Vertical Industry AI

Patent analysis and R&D intelligence, retail shelf visual recognition, NLP document intelligence, e-commerce visual search, logistics fulfillment predictive analytics, agricultural planting environment optimization... AI is penetrating the boundaries of every traditional industry. These companies tell us: the AI-driven commercial revolution is not happening only in the internet sector.

The List Is Here

The 30 companies above represent different dimensions of Singapore's AI ecosystem — veterans with a decade of Asia-Pacific depth, and newcomers who have just closed funding; B2B platforms serving the global top 100, and consumer products reaching hundreds of millions of users. They operate in different sectors, but they are changing the world in the same way: making AI truly enter the bloodstream of business and daily life.

In Closing

AI is not a sector — it is a foundational capability.

What makes Singapore unique is that it is one of the world's best "AI testing grounds." A mature regulatory system, internationally open capital channels, multicultural integration genes, and strong radiating power across Asia-Pacific and global markets — these give AI companies growing here natural conditions for cross-market expansion.

SG AI 30 is a record, and also a starting point. We hope this list helps more people see the innovative forces reshaping Asia-Pacific and the global commercial landscape.

The future is already here — they are already on their way.
